name: Guard Amulet
description: Jointly produced by Pinku and Romanian origami crane artists. Legend has it that if you fold a paper crane a day and stick to it for a thousand days, you can bring happiness to yourself and the people you like. Thousand Wish Cranes carry beautiful wishes and blessings, and each model has a different wish - to protect health, popularity, wealth, good luck, home and luck. At the same time, it is also Pinku’s first metal sheet blind box. There are 6 types of blind boxes, selected at random, and come with exclusive customized accessories - wishing sign, lanyard, wishing guide, full of surprise; 6 types of wishing cranes can be easily collected in the box set, providing 360° good luck blessing. In addition to the exclusive accessories for the blind box, the box set also comes with a decorative stand of thousands of wishing cranes and small easter eggs carefully prepared by the artist. Let’s follow Pinku and the artist to fold thousands of cranes, make wishes, and bring good luck!
